prompt: How many years had the then-Prime Minister of France been in office as PM when the first Shelby GT500 was built?
answer: Georges Pompidou was France’s prime minister when the first Shelby GT500 was built in **1967**. He had taken office on **14 April 1962**, so he had been prime minister for **about five years**.
